subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: Should the final stacked head remove the temporary `@openclaw/qa-matrix` package and private runtime facade after the documentation redirects are restored and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 is ready to land?
rationale: The implementation direction is established, but deleting a workspace package and compatibility surface requires coordinated stack ordering and repository-admin or security authorization for the exact final SHA.

options.title: Complete and authorize the stack
options.body: Restore both redirects, verify the dependent PR order, and authorize the intentional dependency deletion on the unchanged final head.

options.title: Retain the compatibility surface
options.body: Pause this cleanup and keep the temporary package and facade if the preceding stack will not land as one coordinated migration.

recommendation.title: Complete and authorize the stack
recommendation.body: Restore both redirects, verify the dependent PR order, and authorize the intentional dependency deletion on the unchanged final head.
